scope: Three barren-fig originals viewed at original detail for sequence continuity and Luke 13:6–8 fit.
globalConditions: Unnamed characters and precise scenery are artistic visualization of Jesus' parable.
Technical review is not owner approval or final browser acceptance.

entries.alt: An owner lifts the leaves of a fig tree while a gardener holding a long-handled tool watches nearby.
entries.caption: The owner looks among the leaves and finds no fruit. In Jesus' parable, his repeated search brings a serious question about the tree's place in the vineyard.
entries.findings: Broad lobed leaves support fig-tree depiction, with no identifiable fruit visible. Raised fingers meet foliage naturally; arm, head and upward searching gaze are coherent. Gardener, tool and rocky vineyard setting are plausible. Photographic skin, hair and cloth.
conditions: Exact tree shape, palace-free vineyard scenery and gestures are imagined; do not claim a botanical cultivar or verified historical location.

entries.alt: A gardener holding a wooden tool handle gestures toward the fig tree while its owner listens with a hand at his beard.
entries.caption: The gardener asks the owner to leave the tree for another year. His appeal includes a promise of work: digging around it and nourishing the soil.
entries.findings: Owner's receding gray hair, beard and burgundy wrap match scene 01. Gardener's gray beard, tan head wrap and olive tunic remain consistent. Reciprocal face-directed attention is credible; open palm, tool grip and beard hand are coherent. Same broad lobed fruitless tree and vineyard context.
conditions: Do not describe the owner's listening pose as a recorded acceptance or announce a later outcome.

entries.alt: A gardener works the soil around a fig tree with a hoe beside a basket of dark material.
entries.caption: The gardener's proposed care is pictured here: digging around the tree and adding nourishment. Jesus leaves its later fruitfulness unstated; the image visualizes the work promised in the appeal, not a reported outcome.
entries.findings: Gardener's face, head wrap, beard and olive robe preserve continuity. Both hands wrap coherently around a straight hoe handle; metal blade meets loosened soil plausibly. Bending posture, visible sandal and task-directed gaze are natural. Basket and dark material illustrate proposed nourishment without visible fruit or a transformed tree.
conditions: Must retain the distinction between proposed care and a documented later event.
Do not identify the basket contents as a scientifically verified fertilizer or claim the tree subsequently bore fruit.
